decision.legalBasis: FCA Handbook CONC 7.20.1R, inserted by the Consumer Credit (Deferred Payment Credit) Instrument 2026 (FCA 2026/2), PS26/1 Annex F
decision.reclassificationEvidence: Quoted text is CONC 7.20.1R(2), a rule (R) set out as new text in the legal instrument on PDF p.95.
decision.quotation: As soon as possible after a missed payment has occurred the firm must: (a) notify the borrower: (i) that the missed payment has occurred; and (ii) about any sums which have become payable under the regulated deferred payment credit agreement but remain unpaid (including unpaid charges for non-compliance with the agreement)

supplementaryQuotations.quotation: (3) The information required under (2) must be provided together.
